paite: Aw nou Jakob heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmte aw: Ngaikhia unla, ka hon ngen hi ka chi ahi; vaihawmdan na theih ding uh hilou hia?
heading: Israel Vaihawmte Leh Zawlnei Takloute
english: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

paite: Thil hoih na hua ua, thil hoih lou na it ua, avun uh na hawksak ua, aguh ua kipan in sa na leukhia uh.
english: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

paite: Ka mite sa ne in; avun uh na lip ua, aguh uh na hihtansak ua; ahi, sa uina bel sung a sa atnen bang in huan ding in na atnen uhi.
english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

paite: Huai hun chiang in TOUPA asam ding ua, himahleh amau adawng kei ding; ahi, huai hun chiang in athilhih ua ahihhoih louhdan bang un, amau a kipan amai asel ding hi.
english: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

paite: Ka mite thil hihkhialsak mi, nek ding banghiam piak a a-om chiang ua, "Muanna" chi a kikou a, huai bang peloute peuhmah kidouna thu a vaulau zawlneite tungtang thu TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

paite: "Huaiziak in kilakna na neihlouhna ding un noute kiang zan hong tung hi; aisan na bawl theihlouhna ding un na kiang uah mialna ahong om ding a; zawlneite a ding in ni atum ding a, amau tung ah sun amial ding hi.
english: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

paite: Mutheite azum ding ua, aisan siamte azahlak ding uh, avek un amuk uh ahum ding uh; Pathian in adawn louh ziak in."
english: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”

paite: Himahleh Jakob kiang ah atatlekna uh theisak ding leh Israelte kiang ah akhelhna uh theisak ding in TOUPA kha ziak athilhihtheihnate, vaihawmnate, hatnate in ka dim hi.
english: But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

paite: Nou Jakob inkote heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmmi, vaihawmna kih a, dikna chiteng lumlet mite aw, hiai ngaikhia un, ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

paite: Sisan in Zion leh ginatlouhna in Jerusalem alam uh.
english: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

paite: Huai ah heutute'n kipahman lamen in vai ahawm ua, siampute'n loh lamen in asinsak ua, azawlneite'n dangka lamen in ai asan uhi; huchi in leng, TOUPA alak uah a-om kei a hia? I tung uah thil hoih lou ahong tung kei ding, chi in TOUPA tung ah akinga uhi.
english: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh among us? No disaster will come on us.”

paite: Huaiziak in Zion, noute ziak in, lou bang a leileh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thilsia omkhawm ahi ding a, tang a inn omna gammang bang ahi ding.
english: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
